title: Session start failed: clock not synchronized or other error
body:
Good afternoon. The dexcom g6 sensor stopped. I couldn't launch it.
In the "event log" I found the error "Session start failed: clock not synchronized or other error"
I tried restarting the sensor and even performing a hard reset of the transmitter, but to no avail. 5 minutes after the start, it gives a message that the sensor is stopped and offers to start (and so on in a circle)
Then I changed the sensor to a new one - the same mistake.

Has anyone encountered this problem?

hdrip+ (Last updated Nov 2021)
samsung s10+ (android 11)
